%1$s was edited by hand, so Build It did not rewrite it. The library list here is what the on-device build uses.

AndroidX, Material Components, Google Play services, Firebase and plain Java/Android libraries from Google Maven and Maven Central: their code, resources, manifests and native libraries are built into your APK. Firebase needs google-services.json in the app folder (Build It reads it like the Google Services Gradle plugin). Not supported on the device: annotation processors (e.g. Room, Glide compiler), Kotlin-only and Jetpack Compose APIs (projects are Java), and other Gradle plugins such as Crashlytics.
